abundance.purpose: What each abundance layer APB2 writes measures, and whether the software normalizes it across runs: intensity, MS1 intensity, MaxLFQ, iBAQ or directLFQ, normalized never or as the run's settings chose. Every layer an APB2 rule marks with the role abundance carries an entry, except DIA-NN's gene-group Genes.MaxLFQ on the protein-group level.
used_by: apb-proteobench: modules that ask for an abundance normalization, such as dia_plasma

identification_confidence.purpose: How likely each identification, or the signal quantified for it, is correct: per-run PEP and q-value layers, per-feature PEP, Sage's MS1-peak q-value, DIA-NN's and Spectronaut's protein-group q-values per run, per library and across the experiment, and MaxQuant's across the experiment. Scores, vendor summaries and other vendors' protein-level confidence are left out.
used_by: apb-aggregate: confidence-weighted rollups rlm_confidence_case and rlm_confidence_precision
apb-export: the prolfqua target's qValue, pg_qValue and pg_qValue_experiment layers

proteobench_entrapment.purpose: The precursor q-values ProteoBench's entrapment scoring ranks by: run, library and experiment-wide q-values on the ion level, each its own kind. Only the vendors ProteoBench's entrapment module accepts carry entries.
